My rerun (0H, out_of_domain) is what that current source produces; hand-verified by inspection of DICY's SMILES (NC(=N)NC#N): both its NH2 and bridging NH neighbor the same guanidine carbon, which bears a C=N bond, so both are excluded under the rule as written. The committed diagnostic.canonical.json (written 2026-08-02) and R-A12's own probe_reattack_runA.json (2026-08-03, same day as R-A12) both instead record hardener/4H -- the pre-fix behavior.
